formulaBlock.normalization: No split synonym entries; normalized positions = packet positions. E3: no Parfum declared -> first listed preservative Benzyl Alcohol (8); prominent = 1-7.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: SLES (2) is the defining ether-type anionic, buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine (3) and Coco-Betaine (7), no reinforcing strong anionic -> moderate.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Little refatting (only PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate 6) and no conditioning polymer, so the net feel leans to the cleansing side; does not move the C1 convention.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Cleansing-led architecture: no cationic polymer, no silicone, no payload lipid; only a weak refatter (PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate 6), a late pearlizer (Glycol Distearate 12) and late Glycerin (18).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate and Glycol Distearate give some softness; not a meaningful conditioning system.

weightPotential.rationale: Only deposition clue is one weak refatter (PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate 6) facing an effective C1 chassis; tea tree oil is a fragrance/essential oil (excluded).

depositionLoad.rationale: single weak_refatter; no cationic, silicone or payload lipid

persistence.rationale: weak refatter is not retained through rinsing

resetCapacity.rationale: C1 SLES + two betaines, effective ordinary chassis

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Deposition is absent apart from a weak refatter; nothing supports noticeable residue.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: moderate would need at least one plausibly persistent depositing system; there is none (single family, W2 not triggered).

dandruffSupport.rationale: Complete INCI contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole; tea tree oil does not upgrade (Section 11).

focusPrimary.rationale: Formula alone is nonspecific. Formula is compatible with clarifying (F6: cleansing moderate, conditioning not high, weight not high) if oily/reset positioning appears; prominent tea tree oil hints at a scalp/purifying role, which needs claims.

usageRole.rationale: Default; triggers need claims (cleansing is moderate, so alternating is impossible).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Positioning hidden. Formula half (CSA): passes via prominent PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate (6, E4 humectant/refatting); no prominent E4 comfort route, so an S-SENSITIVE gate would fail; prominent tea tree essential oil (4) is a counter-signal.

careDirection.rationale: No humectant cluster or deposition cluster; formula supports no repair/moisture direction.
